recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Avoid adding redundant datatype prose unless a future work-group decision reopens the Observation boolean/coded-value guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-8605 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that the Data Types page explain how boolean-like Observation values should be represented, originally by using valueCodeableConcept with HL7 v2 Yes/No because Observation did not then have valueBoolean.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify svn revision 6604. The corresponding git-svn commit fb66d5178323d942348b8b591562a2d8da7a0b91, titled '#8605 - add note about coded values for boolean in primitive data type definitions', added the datatype-page note linking HL7 V2 Table 0136 and Observation value[x], plus the Observation anchor used by that link.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps general type pages to datatypes.html and includes Observation as an active resource. Current source/datatypes.html still has the boolean coded-value note. Current Observation source includes boolean in Observation.value[x] and its notes mention valueBoolean and valueCodeableConcept with v2 Yes/No options. Related final issues FHIR-6344 and FHIR-10275 explain the progression from coded-value guidance to direct valueBoolean support.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the requested explanation is present and later Observation changes make the current specification more permissive than the original DSTU1 context.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive Observation issue requested guidance for representing valueBoolean-like observations with valueCodeableConcept and v2 Table 0136. It is useful context but was not decided here because it is an Observation issue with its own application path.

Later Published/Persuasive Observation issue added boolean to Observation.value[x], changing the old assumption while preserving the datatype note's usefulness. It was not decided here because the seed only requires the datatype-page audit.
